page.title: Optional Extras: the emphasis Neave set and the site lost
page.standfirst_html:
The checker reports 93 lost runs on Optional Extras, plus 35 added and 7 swapped. I checked every one against the source page image, because pdftotext discards emphasis, so the image is the only place these claims can be checked.

If you accept every proposal, Optional Extras goes from 93 lost to 0, 35 added to 0 and 7 swapped to 0. I measured that by re-running the checker on a copy with all 134 proposals applied.

This appendix needs more judgement than Day 3 or Day 7. Restore italics (56 cards) opens preset to Restore, so skim it. Fix proposed (71 cards) is not preset. Most of those are italics the site put on the wrong words: 13 to remove and 20 spans too long or too short. Three groups should each get one decision applied to every card in the group:

  • Contents list (7 cards, p5): the source sets every top-level entry bold. The site's list is plain links, and no convention covers that.
  • Φ(z) (6 cards, pp96–97): the source sets Φ upright and z italic. The proposal is $\Phi(z)$; the alternative is Φ(*z*).
  • Japanese Control Chart (4 cards, pp32–33): the site italicises it everywhere, but the source only italicises it on p27. The proposal follows the source.

Wording (8 cards) is new for an emphasis pass. While reading the pages, the checks turned up words the site changed, dropped or added, none of them in the deviation log. One is a logged correction that never reached the site: the log says the site reads “becomes”, but it still says “become”.
